name: Happy Tree Friends
description: This action and adventure comedy is drawn in simple appearance and combines cute forest animals with extreme graphic violence. Each episode revolves around the characters enduring accidental events of bloodshed, pain, dismemberment and/or death.

Happy Tree Friends x Dumb Ways to Die - Happy Train Friends
videos.overview: Like peanut butter and jelly-- Happy Tree Friends is smushed together with Dumb Ways to Die in this powerhouse collab! Two great oozy, sticky treats brought together to form one delicious episode! Get on board as characters from both worlds collide on a one-way track to AWESOME!

videos.title: Spin Fun Knowin' Ya
videos.overview: Spin Fun is the very first Happy Tree Friends episode! This show introduces the core character group and also sets up the theme of "innocent mayhem" that runs throughout the entire series. Lumpy is spinning the gang on a merry-go-round, only to have things spiral out of control. A clip of this show was seen in Jennifer Aniston's movie, "The Good Girl.

videos.title: House Warming
videos.overview: Handy, the resident carpenter beaver with no hands, builds Petunia a lovely new home. How does he do this with no hands? Some secrets may never be revealed! The project turns into a disaster when a fire breaks out and Handy has to come to Petunia's rescue.

videos.title: Helping Helps
videos.overview: Poor Giggles has a broken leg and is limping along when she's nearly crushed and drowned in a tidal wave caused by a dam breaking. Luckily, Splendid the flying squirrel saves the day, but not without incident! This episode is the only time you meet Giggles' mom, one of the only adults in Happy Tree Friends. Do you know who the other adult character is?

videos.title: Crazy Ant-ics
videos.overview: Brainy anteater Sniffles doesn't quite use his head when digging in this particular ant hole. His tasty treat turns ugly when the ants take their revenge. Do you notice what is hidden in the ant hole? Be wary of hidden treasure!

videos.title: Havin' A Ball
videos.overview: A friendly game of catch goes horribly wrong for this father and son bear. Pop tries to impress Cub with his ball handling skills, but disaster ensues and a rescue chopper goes down. So sad that even the simple things go so wrong in Happy Tree Friends Land.

videos.title: Water You Wading For?
videos.overview: Cuddles is always trying to lure scared Flaky into some sort of trouble! In this episode, Cuddles wants Flaky to join him in the local swim hole... little does he know that what you don't see beneath the water can hurt you!

videos.title: Nuttin' Wrong With Candy!
videos.overview: Vending Machines can be so cruel when the thing you want gets stuck, but that won't stop Nutty from getting his money's worth.

videos.title: Wheelin' and Dealin'
videos.overview: It's off to the races in this episode of Happy Tree Friends! Start your engines and gear up to win, but watch out for Lifty and Shifty, as they'll do anything necessary to keep the lead.

videos.title: Pitchin' Impossible
videos.overview: What's more fun than trying your luck at midway games? It might be harder than you think if you can't see, but give it your best shot and win a squeezable prize!

videos.title: Stayin' Alive
videos.overview: Introducing Disco Bear, that lovable beast that never grew out of the '70s. His flirtatious ways get him in a heap o' trouble with Giggles and Petunia! Lucky for him that disco never really died.

videos.title: Treasure Those Idol Moments
videos.overview: The gang that plays together... dies together! The idol makes a starring appearance in this show and proves just how dangerous it can be to play with hidden treasures. Millions of Fans argued that this episode was based on the Brady Bunch (remember their vacation in Hawaii?), and others say Raiders of the Lost Ark. What do you think??

videos.title: Chip Off the Ol' Block
videos.overview: Ah, the smell of fresh cut grass... and blood and guts. When your parents tell you not to stick your hands in the machinery, you better listen! Oh, and don't play with fire either. It's really, really dangerous!

videos.title: Nuttin' but the Tooth
videos.overview: Did Toothy go to dental school or is he just learning as he goes? Nutty's candy cravings lead to a rotten tooth, and it's Toothy to the rescue. Lumpy makes a brief appearance, just in time to save the day!

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Be prepared for your first introduction to Flippy, the troubled war veteran bear who suffers regular flashbacks. Flippy is the only Happy Tree Friend that intentionally inflicts harm on his fellow friends, which is how an innocent game of hide and seek turns deadly.

videos.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
videos.overview: This episode introduces Russell, a pirate sea otter whose vocabulary only consists of "Yarr!" and who has a love for shellfish.

videos.title: Boo Do You Think You Are?
videos.overview: Our first Halloween episode proves that Flaky really does have something to be scared about! A haunted house ride turns a little too real for our Happy gang. Maybe they should have gone trick-or-treating instead!

videos.title: Mime and Mime Again
videos.overview: Sweet Mime is just trying to bring joy to injured Toothy, but he can't quite get it right. Making balloon animals is harder than it looks! By the way, do you know what kind of animal Mime is? He is a deer.

videos.title: You're Bakin' Me Crazy
videos.overview: Trying hard to sell cookies for her troop, Giggles walks into a Lumpy disaster and gets more than she bargained for. Never bake and iron at the same time. Didn't your mother teach you anything???

videos.title: Tongue Twister Trouble
videos.overview: A leisurely ice skate goes horribly wrong in this snowy Happy Tree Friends episode. The ants once again take revenge on Sniffles the anteater. He just can't get a break!

videos.title: Meat Me for Lunch
videos.overview: The kleptomaniac raccoon brothers are at it again, stealing meat from Lumpy the butcher. They learn the hard way that crime doesn't pay, and Petunia ends up with the just desserts.

videos.title: Sweet Ride
videos.overview: That Nutty just can't resist a sweet treat! Luckily Cuddles is smooth on the skateboard and out-maneuvers Nutty at every turn. His last trick is a head-roller!!!

videos.title: It's a Snap
videos.overview: Lumpy manages to get in all sorts of trouble, and this episode is no exception. Splendid does his best to save Lumpy from certain death, but it just doesn't turn out exactly the way he planned. Why would a moose eat cheese anyway?

videos.title: Off the Hook
videos.overview: Lumpy's relaxing day of fishing is anything but fun for Russell the sea otter pirate! Swimming along, eating clams, Russell gets caught -- hook, line and sinker!

videos.title: Spare Me
videos.overview: Bowling. What could be more fun than bowling with a gang of friends? Well, if one of them is blind and the other has no hands, it may not be so much fun after all. Maybe they should have used the guard rails on those lanes?

videos.title: Snow What? That's What!
videos.overview: Building snowmen, making snow angels and throwing snow balls are fun winter activities for our cuddly gang. But what do you do when one friend is trapped solid in a block of ice? Giggles finds out in a hurry!

videos.title: This Is Your Knife
videos.overview: It's so much fun to go camping and roast marshmallows with your friends! But sparks soon fly as Flippy warps into his post-traumatic alter-ego. Remember those horror stories you told around the campfire? Watch out, cause this one comes true!

videos.title: Happy Trails (Part 1)
videos.overview: It's no surprise that trouble abounds on the school bus and Lumpy just can't pull it together to save the gang from harm. What happens to our lovable cast? Do they survive? Will they return? Our only cliffhanger episode leaves fans clamoring for more!

videos.title: Happy Trails: Jumping the Shark (2)
videos.overview: Castaway on a deserted island, the gang must figure out how to get home. They battle sharks, sinking life boats and out-of-control rockets just to make it back to their favorite forest. Do they succeed? Tune in to Part Two to find out!

videos.title: Eye Candy
videos.overview: One of our most requested episodes, Eye Candy has a high degree of cringe factor! What is it about the eyes that make people squirm so much? It's hard to watch Eye Candy without a real physical reaction, but that's the beauty of this episode. Eye Candy won a prize at the Annecy Film Festival in France and continues to be a real fan favorite.

videos.title: Rink Hijinks
videos.overview: Remember how fun it was to go to roller skating? Flaky tries her luck on the rink and Disco Bear shows off his fancy twirls. Meanwhile, Lumpy ends up in a jam and Cub wins a one-of-a-kind prize at an arcade game.

videos.title: Flippin' Burgers
videos.overview: Fast food is an integral part of our culture, and it's no different in the world of Happy Tree Friends. Yes, they might use different condiments than we do, but even fluffy cute creatures have to eat. Did you want extra sauce with that? Good eatin'!

videos.title: Get Whale Soon
videos.overview: Funny how these two characters end up in another wet, dark, disastrous situation! Stranded in the belly of a whale, Lumpy and Russell pool their resources to find a way out. Will they get eaten alive or do they find their way to freedom? It's an adventure you don't want to miss!

videos.title: Snip, Snip Hooray!
videos.overview: It's son's first haircut and oh how excited he is! Playing with all those sharp, shiny objects like scissors and razors are just the thing to make a kid squeal with delight. It is delight, right? Not sharp, shooting pain?

videos.title: Eyes Cold Lemonade
videos.overview: The simple pleasures of a summertime lemonade stand take a turn for the worst in Eyes Cold Lemonade. Not enough sugar to sweeten that drink? We've got just the thing for you. Hand over your cup for another round and drink up!

videos.title: Milkin' It
videos.overview: Things are not as simple as they seem down on the farm. Lifty and Shifty make off with Lumpy's cow, only to get tangled up in some electrifying events. This episode is sure to set off some sparks!

videos.title: Out of Sight, Out of Mime
videos.overview: Welcome to our second Halloween special! How do a blind mole and a silent mime communicate? It's typical haunted mayhem in this scary episode.

videos.title: Class Act
videos.overview: This is the first Holiday episode we made and it features the entire cast. You have to admire Lumpy's attitude that the show must go on, but sometimes there is even too much disaster for even the Happy Tree Friends gang to handle. In true holiday spirit, they pull together for a tear-jerk ending. Peace to everyone.

videos.title: The Way You Make Me Wheel
videos.overview: Lumpy's late for work and tries to save time by shaving while driving. Big mistake? Nah. Handy's got it all under control... or does he???

videos.title: Better Off Bread
videos.overview: Splendid the Superhero is making bread when he suddenly senses trouble in the neighborhood! Can he save his furry friends in time?

videos.title: I Get a Trick Out of You
videos.overview: Lumpy entertains the group at a party, only to wind up in the emergency room. Funny how that seems to happen a lot on Happy Tree Friends! Will he stop his trickery? Only when he's gone too far.

videos.title: Shard at Work
videos.overview: Handy tries to screw in a light bulb but screws up in the end.

videos.title: Water Way to Go
videos.overview: Pop and Cub go to the beach for some sun, sand, and a sea of blood.

videos.title: Out on a Limb
videos.overview: Lumberjack Lumpy yells "Timber!" then help!

videos.title: Keepin' It Reel
videos.overview: When the Happy Tree Friends go to the movies, they're expecting their money's worth.. but what happens when Flippy accompanies them?

videos.title: A Hard Act to Swallow
videos.overview: Sniffles the Anteater can't help but eat the ants, and the ants set out to make him regret it.

videos.title: Let it Slide
videos.overview: The gang goes swimming at the local water park for some slips, slides and severs.

videos.title: Icy You
videos.overview: Nutty, with his usual large sugar tooth, takes it upon himself to test out the new slushie machine. However, a series of events makes him regret this as the coldness really puts him into his place.

videos.title: Hello Dolly
videos.overview: Petunia finds a statue in the park and picks it up to take with her. This statue starts to wreak some unexpected havoc.

videos.title: Remains to be Seen
videos.overview: Trick-or-treating takes a beating when Flippy flips and runs over all the Happy Tree Friends while transporting some nuclear waste. Lumpy gives everyone a proper burial, but it seems no one is ready yet as they've all been turned into zombies!!

videos.title: Stealing the Spotlight
videos.overview: Lumpy tries to outbest Pop in a battle of the brightest, in Christmas lights decorations! Who will hold the candle?

videos.title: Ski Ya, Wouldn't Want to be Ya!
videos.overview: Get ready for thrills, chills, and spills when the show goes downhill, when Flaky skis down a hill, that is.

videos.title: Blind Date
videos.overview: Mole, who is blind, is set up on a blind date. However, disaster and awkwardness occur on this particular one. How does this turn out for Mole and his date?

videos.title: Suck it Up
videos.overview: Poor Sniffles has the sniffles. Now the ants can have their fun and take his cookies, too. But Sniffles still has a few tricks up his sleeve, or rather, his nose when he brings out a new contraption to rid those pesky little ants.

videos.title: From A to Zoo (1)
videos.overview: The Happy Tree Friends are on a field trip to the zoo! And the fun starts when Lumpy loses track of the kids!

videos.title: From A to Zoo (2)
videos.overview: Lumpy attempts to gather the kids back onto the bus to conclude their field trip.

videos.title: Read 'em and Weep
videos.overview: When Pop picks up an odd book at a discounted price to read to Cub, some strange changes unfold.

videos.title: Can't Stop Coffin
videos.overview: When Cuddles jumps a fence to go after a baseball, he finds himself in quite a spot.

videos.title: We're Scrooged!
videos.overview: In a strange turn of events, Lumpy Scrooge finds the next "big thing" in the toy business.

videos.title: A Sucker for Love (1)
videos.overview: Nutty's candy addiction drives him to the edge.

videos.title: A Sucker for Love (2)
videos.overview: The conclusion to Nutty's wild ride.  Plus, we find out what happened to Cub.

videos.title: Just Desert
videos.overview: Lumpy finds himself a nice lake...in the middle of the desert?

videos.title: Peas in a Pod
videos.overview: Lumpy accidentally plants a magical seed, and grows some new friends.  But, things quickly get out of hand.

videos.title: Wrath of Con
videos.overview: Nerds unite! A trek to the comic book convention to meet their hero leaves them breathless.

videos.title: All Flocked Up
videos.overview: Hilarity ensues when Lumpy’s bird-brained attempts to replace a wayward chick to its nest turn “fowl!”

videos.title: Something Fishy
videos.overview: Class is back in session! The gang has brought in their pets for show-and-tell but Russell’s scaly friend has more than a passing interest in the school body.

videos.title: Without a Hitch
videos.overview: In the dead of night, Flaky finds that unimaginable terror lurks at every turn. Fasten your seat-belts for a one way trip straight to the end of the road!

videos.title: Swelter Skelter
videos.overview: Things heat up for Lifty & Shifty when they try to chill out. Tempers flare but will cooler heads prevail?

videos.title: I Nub You
videos.overview: Ah, “nub” is in the air! Watch Petunia find out the answer to the eternal question: is it better to have “nubbed” and lost than to never have “nubbed” at all?

videos.title: A Bit of a Pickle
videos.overview: Make room at the table because the world of Happy Tree Friends gets a few new residents. Welcome Lammy and Mr. Pickels in their debut episode!

videos.title: The Choke's on You
videos.overview: Our most recent episode kicks us off when Lumpy chokes on the job and is forced to go through a bunch of mishaps!

videos.title: Random Acts of Silence
videos.overview: Don’t forget to be quiet in the library. When Flippy is the librarian, it might save your life.

videos.title: Breaking Wind
videos.overview: There’s a bad wind blowing into town and it’s up to Splendid to rise to the occasion!

videos.title: All In Vein
videos.overview: In the still of the night your deepest, darkest nightmares arise! A tale so chilling it will turn your blood cold! Beware the horror of Count Lumpy!

videos.title: Bottled Up Inside
videos.overview: All the fun of a “Ship in a Bottle”, only less time consuming and (arguably) messier!

videos.title: No Time Like the Present
videos.overview: It wouldn’t be Christmas without a season themed episode! Happy Holidays!

videos.title: By The Seat of Your Pants
videos.overview: Lumpy has Flippy over to watch a swimming competition on T.V. but is caught with his pants down. It’s sink or swim time as Lumpy tries to keep one step ahead of Flippy. Which one of them is going to get caught “underwear”?

videos.title: You're Kraken Me Up
videos.overview: Russell serenades Giggles on a boat ride. We find out just how much of a sucker for love he truly is. Meanwhile, Lumpy fulfills his lifeguard duties and jumps in at the first sign of danger. Will he get sucked into trouble too?

videos.title: All Work and No Play
videos.overview: Nutty, Sniffles and Lammy discover an old, broken down playground being demolished by Lumpy. Wackiness (and injuries) ensue as the kids hurt themselves on the dangerous equipment and Lumpy tries to lend a hand.

videos.title: Buns of Steal
videos.overview: Hold on to your buns! Lifty & Shifty try to pull off a daring, daylight heist on the baked goods truck. Watch this episode… then watch your carbs!

videos.title: Camp Pokeneyeout
videos.overview: Camp Pokeneyeout is an episode of the Happy Tree Friends Internet series, it is the eighth of Season 4 and 86th overall. It premiered in January 16th, along with the game based on the episode, Deadeye Derby.
